diameterInterpretation: Published conservative radar-model effective diameter 0.63 km with +0.13/-0.06 km uncertainty; no catalog diameter rescales the archived vertices.
limitations: This is the paper’s conservative single-lobe working model, not a uniquely resolved shape. Radar data cover about half a rotation, and the degree of bifurcation remains uncertain. The pole is uncertain by tens of degrees; the sidereal period is 15.0 ± 0.2 hours. No resolved optical surface map is supplied.
radiusInterpretation: Half the 0.63 km equivalent diameter of the conservative single-lobe working model; diameter uncertainty is +0.13/-0.06 km. Original vertices are not rescaled.
